description: Files copied into tests/vendor/ from other repositories, each pinned by SHA-256. tests/unit/vendor.test.mjs checks them offline: every file under tests/vendor/ is listed here (or is one of the folder's own files), and every listed file has its SHA-256. tests/vendor/check-upstream.mjs compares them with the upstream copies and prints a note when upstream differs, never a failure. A refresh copies the new files, updates their SHA-256 and the commit, and runs the tests that use them.

They hold expected values only (SHA-256 digests, chain ids, Merkle roots, byte counts) and generated test data. The two verb shards (texts/11-verb-00.txt, texts/12-verb-01.txt) are WordNet 3.0 glosses (Princeton University) under the WordNet licence, LICENSE-WORDNET.txt, copied with them.
